Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: why they made this prediction, ● in groups, learners are guided to answer questions that activate previous 1. How can we enhance comprehension of a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
self-efficacy : the learner engages actively with others as they collaboratively rewrite the events and sections of a text in their

own words.

Values:
Respect: The learner acknowledges responses of peers as they jointly answer questions that activate previous knowledge about

the subject before reading a text.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Peaceful conflict management: The learner exercises peaceful conflict management when they collaboratively rewrite the

events and sections of a text in their own words.
